overview: You wrote Saturday's share as six-and-twenty shillings, and under it that the coffer stands as ruled on the twenty-second, at twenty pound fifteen shillings. You did not add the share. You did not make a new total.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.

assets.name: six-and-twenty shillings
assets.disposition: Wrote six-and-twenty beside the old ruling
